translations.web: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.
translations.bsb: The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me? Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!
